description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hangamuwa, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830151 (23/1200143)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title settlement, cadastral maps, and property ownership claims in multiple districts (Hambantota and Kegalle), which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
